title: The Drowned Salt
author: Elodie Joubert
blurb: Lior Oyelaran, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
